statement: Exploratory and post hoc: the result is a candidate at most and changes no registered reading, flag or decision.
not_done_or_provisional: No test outside tests_enumerated.json (first pass, 137 tests, raw variance) and tests_enumerated_signal.json (second pass, 137 tests, signal variance) was run, and none of their tests was altered.

The second pass is not fixed in advance. It was added on 12 Nov 2026 after the join of the raw variance, by decision of the lead, who had seen no result; the worker who listed and ran it had seen the first pass. Every test of it is a reading not fixed in advance. The primary test of the analysis is PRIMARY of the first pass (raw variance, the quantity every post-run review names 'measured' and on which the ratios the plan quotes are formed).

Provisional: for 39 points of day 2 the measured value is the figure printed in the review, a variance with divisor M and rounded as printed, because the registered estimate (divisor M - 1) does not reproduce it at the printed precision (rule fixed in tests_enumerated.json). The registered estimate is beside it (`measured_registered_estimator`, `r_registered_estimate`, `r_signal_registered_estimate` in `joined_points.csv`). Both passes were repeated with the registered estimate: no outcome differs: the primary test and each of its readings, in both passes, fall on the same side of 0.05, and the rejections of the first-pass family and of the union are the same. Tests of either pass whose p crosses 0.05 between the two: 0. Largest change of any p: 0.004. The repetition enters no family.

Provisional: the frozen table lists 2 jobs and 400 draws for (`paper1_day2_main_grid`, grid n85 L8 k1 r2 s4096) while the tidy table holds 100 draws from 1 job(s). The point was joined on the draws the review reports; its calibration columns in the frozen table still reflect every job the table lists.

2 of 67 points were left out of both passes because the post-run review prints no measured value for them (`paper1_day2_main_grid`, grid n37 L12 k12 r1 s4096; `paper1_day2_main_grid`, grid n85 L12 k12 r1 s4096); no value was estimated in their place.

10 further points have no r_signal and are out of the second pass only: 10 marked by their review as at the shot floor (every L = 12 point of day 1 and of the day-2 main grid), 0 whose signal variance is not positive.
The check of each point's prediction row against the review is a comparison of printed figures; for points where the review states no prediction value (level-2 and k = L points) it could not be made.
The table is the provisional one (own implementation of the per-value rule of draft Deviation 65); the repetition on the table rebuilt with the adopted builder (plan Section 9) is not done.
No independent check of these results has been made (plan Section 6 asks for one before the result is quoted anywhere).
No measured value was re-estimated by another method; no prediction was re-drawn; no IBM service was called.
